single.rationale: Standex shows acquisition-driven growth with 17% sales contribution from deals, but deteriorating fundamentals are concerning: organic sales declined 7.5%, operating income fell to $93.5M from $101.7M, and FCF collapsed to $41.3M while debt surged to $552.5M from $148.9M to fund the $467.5M Amran/Narayan acquisition. The 71x P/E and 96x P/FCF valuations appear extremely stretched given declining organic performance and integration risks from multiple concurrent acquisitions across different segments.
